dedupe_keys.name: gcp gridfedv2020 1 updated gridded fossil co2 and o2 package

description: GCP-GridFEDv2020.1 is a later release of the global fossil carbon dioxide and oxygen-uptake grids, extending monthly coverage through 2019. The own Zenodo metadata states a 0.1-degree grid, separates fossil source classes and lists a large release archive. The describing Scientific Data article cites this update as the source of calculation code that follows the same method as v2019.1. A modeller can use the later release to update historical emission priors for energy or industry scenarios, while keeping its version separate from older results. It is based on inventory estimates and spatial disaggregation, not observed emissions at every grid point; uncertainty should be retained when coarsening. Zenodo states CC BY 4.0. I read repository metadata but did not download the archive or inspect embedded code. The related v2019.1 release is a distinct time span and DOI. The earlier sector-routing rejection did not assess this named public deposit.
